query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(p) - 'set_by')
                      || jsonb_build_object('club_name', c.name, 'work_title', w.title)
                  ORDER BY p.id), '[]') AS "rows!"
           FROM club_picks p
           JOIN clubs c ON c.id = p.club_id
           JOIN works w ON w.id = p.work_id
           WHERE p.set_by = $1
